name: @absolutejs/performance
description: Core Web Vitals, server route latency, static asset timing and Postgres health for AbsoluteJS applications — four measurements, one console, Drizzle-native.
author: Alex Kahn

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts src/drizzle.ts --outdir dist --root ./src --sourcemap --target=bun --external drizzle-orm --external 'drizzle-orm/*' && bun build src/client.ts --outdir dist --root ./src --sourcemap --target=browser --format esm && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check:package: bun run format && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.release: bun run check:package && npm publish --access public --tag beta
